messages:
Alex: Quick design q — exploring two layouts for the Usage & Billing panel: 'cardstack' (vertical list, each card expands into invoice rows) vs 'trellis' (compact grid of project tiles). Which helps teams scan spend + token breakdown faster?

Maria: Trellis feels denser and faster for >8 projects. Cardstack is clearer for invoice-first workflows. main worry: trellis deprioritizes the token breakdown metric.

Sam: Agree w/ Maria. Trellis wins for overview but we need a persistent token-summary row or a hover affordance. Otherwise people miss per-project token spikes.

Jamie: What about a hybrid rule: trellis for multi-project views, auto-switch to cardstack when a single project or invoice is selected. That maps to the mental model. Also keyboard nav concerns — grid needs proper roving tabindex.

Kyle: Accessibility nit — the token legend chips in the trellis mock are low contrast (approx #6A6A6A on #FFFFFF -> ~3.8:1). Must be >=4.5:1. Also add focus outline for chip keyboard selection.

Alex: UX copy tweak suggestion: change header from `Tokens used` to `Token usage` (noun-first) and the small subcopy: `Includes cached responses` -> `Excludes cached responses by default` to avoid ambiguity.

Maria: +1 copy tweak. Also thinking about CTA density: in cardstack each row has 3 CTAs (download invoice, view details, dispute). In trellis we should collapse secondary actions into a kebab menu to reduce noise.

Sam: Performance note: trellis will render ~50 tiles on load for orgs with many projects — need virtualized list and aggregated spend buckets (week/day) toggles.

Alex: Prototype snippet (very rough):
```css
.usage-trellis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.cardstack .invoice { border-left: 4px solid var(--accent); padding: 12px; }
```

Jamie: Love the hybrid rule. Also add aria-labels: `aria-label="Project spend: <name>"` and ensure tile role=button.

Kyle: Small a11y ask — ensure colorblind-friendly palette for the token legend (avoid red/green only). Use pattern+color for token types in legend.

design-bot: Prototype uploaded to Figma — https://figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (updated trellis + cardstack + hybrid flows). Added accessibility checklist. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Next steps: Maria to iterate trellis prototypes with a visible token-summary strip (top of grid), Sam to spike virtualization perf numbers, Kyle to propose color & focus updates, Jamie to add keyboard nav doc. I'll sync with Eng on feasibility Wednesday.

Maria: I'll drop updated frames by EOD Tuesday.

Sam: I'll run a quick perf estimate and post numbers here.

Kyle: I'll prepare contrast variants and drop hexes.

Jamie: I'll write keyboard nav draft and share before EOD.

Alex: Thanks all :rocket:
